name: runway
description: Runway - investor-grade metrics for founders (pnpm monorepo: backend + frontend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter runway-backend run test && pnpm --filter runway-frontend run test
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run build
scripts.verify:full: pnpm run verify && pnpm run test:db
